title: Add linguistic fingerprint and verbosity fields to CompanionEditor UI
description:
Update the companion editing UI in react_ui/src/components/CompanionEditor.tsx to support modifying the new fingerprint and verbosity properties.

Before editing, inspect:
- react_ui/src/components/CompanionEditor.tsx
acceptance_criteria: react_ui/src/components/CompanionEditor.tsx renders inputs for punctuation_habits, sentence_length_profile, emoji_style, vocabulary_density, slang_profile, and adaptive_verbosity
New field values are saved to state and updated via the editor form
